title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: Cr from GKS under SSIP, Govt. of Gujarat in 2022.   Created academic eco-system for learning and research, including instruments (GC, FTIR, HPLC), facilities (FAB LAB, High Voltage Lab, PLC, CAD/CAM, MATLAP, PSIM, PRO-E), Botanical Garden and Animal House.   Published scientific papers (168) in SCI Journals, granted 6 industrial design and awarded 4 patents out of 45 under examination and 20 more patents under prosecution.
